page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, storage-optimized instance tailored for high-throughput, data-intensive architectures. Powered by dual-socket Intel Xeon 8559C processors on the x86_64 architecture, the system provides 48 physical cores, 96 vCPUs at a 3.2 GHz base clock, and a generous 320 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 768 GB of high-speed 6 GHz DDR5 memory (8 GB per physical core) and directly attaches 60,000 GB (60 TB) of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. There are no discrete GPUs included, relying instead on integrated accelerator instruction sets such as AVX-512, AMX-TILE, and AMX-INT8 alongside a baseline 100 Gbps network interface.

Benchmark results place the i7ie.metal-24xl in the top tier (top 10%) across multiple multi-threaded and data operations. In PassMark, it achieves 95,190.03 points overall, 33,739.36 in database operations, and 115,600.66 in extended CPU instructions. Geekbench confirms top-tier multi-core compute at 22,291.0, with strong scores in Clang compilation (60,981.0) and ray tracing (92,702.0). Raw throughput shows exceptional capabilities, demonstrated by 133.13 GB/sec in static web serving, 117.71 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads, and 547.89 GB/sec in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression.

The qualitative cost-efficiency of the i7ie.metal-24xl stems from its massive resource density and elimination of hypervisor overhead. By pairing 60 TB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage with 768 GB of DDR5 memory and 100 Gbps networking, workloads avoid the latency and compounding costs of external block storage. However, trade-offs exist: while multi-threaded throughput and large-block prompt processing (39.16 tokens/sec on 70B models) are top-tier, single-threaded CPU metrics remain average in stress-ng (2160.09).

Given its massive direct-attached storage footprint, fast memory subsystem, and 96 vCPUs, the i7ie.metal-24xl is best suited for large distributed databases, high-capacity NoSQL clusters, real-time analytics engines, in-memory caching platforms, and data warehousing.
description: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-24xl is a bare-metal storage-optimized instance featuring 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor at 3.2 GHz. The platform is configured with 768 GB of 6 GHz DDR5 RAM, 60,000 GB of high-performance local NVMe SSD storage, and a 100 Gbps network baseline, operating without discrete GPUs. Benchmarks demonstrate top-tier execution across PassMark database operations, Geekbench multi-core compilation, and static web serving reaching 133.13 GB/sec, alongside top-quartile Redis throughput exceeding 117 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth is substantial, with uncached large-block reads achieving 289.33 GB/sec. Providing extensive storage density and dedicated bare-metal execution, this server is well-suited for high-throughput distributed databases, large-scale NoSQL deployments, data warehousing, and intensive transactional workloads.
